description: 911 Daily Dispatch Count by Agency is a dataset listed in City of Boston open data portal (Analyze Boston), an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Innovation and Technology. This a legacy dataset from the period of November 1, 2010 to April 21, 2014 showing daily counts of 911 dispatches by City of Boston public safety agencies. Agencies included are the Boston Police Department, Boston Fire Department, and Boston Emergency Medical Services. Coverage: Boston, Massachusetts. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Innovation and Technology. Its tags are 911, dispatch, legacy portal, public safety. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2019-05-18 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Data Commons Public Domain Dedication and License (PDDL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-boston-portal.
